title: Official DarGlobal project directory
text: The official DarGlobal project directory lists these named developments and locations: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai — Dubai, UAE; D-Villas at Jumeirah Golf Estates — Dubai, UAE; The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin — Al Marjan Island, UAE; DG1 — Dubai, UAE; Da Vinci Tower, Interiors by Pagani — Dubai, UAE; Urban Oasis by Missoni — Dubai, UAE; W Residences — Dubai, UAE; The Pagani Penthouse — Dubai, UAE; Top of The Astera — Al Marjan Island, UAE; Tierra Viva and Painite Villas — Benahavís, Spain; Marea by Missoni — Cortesin, Spain; Les Vagues by Elie Saab — Doha, Qatar; Trump International Simaisma — Simaisma, Qatar; AIDA and its listed residential/hospitality offerings including Azure Oceanfront Villas by Fendi Casa — Muscat, Oman; The Mulliner and 7&8 Albert Hall Mansions — London, United Kingdom; Trump Park Residences, Trump Executive Residences, Amaya Luxury Plots and Padel Living Residences — Jeddah, Saudi Arabia; Trump Mansions and DarGlobal Mansions by Fendi Casa — Rayana, Wadi Safar, Riyadh; Neptune by Mouawad — Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a project directory, not a live inventory or confirmation that any unit is for sale.

title: DarGlobal corporate overview — Q3 2026 website snapshot
text: DarGlobal's corporate homepage describes the company as a London-listed luxury real estate developer, investor and asset manager that owns, invests in, develops and operates high-end real estate. The homepage describes its work as including residential communities and landmark destinations, hospitality, commercial, entertainment and golf-related assets across markets including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain and London. Its headline indicators are 32 years of track record, US$23 billion gross development value, presence in 7 international markets and 12+ global brand partners. The page says these indicative data points are aligned with disclosures as of Q3 2026. The GDV and partner/market counts are dated company-reported portfolio figures, not current individual unit prices or live listings.

title: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai
text: DarGlobal describes Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai as a mixed-use development on Sheikh Zayed Road at the entrance to Downtown Dubai, combining a five-star hotel, private residences and a members-only club. The project page lists one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments and four-bedroom duplex penthouses, with unit areas from 109 to 722 square metres. Status: under development. Expected completion: December 2031. The page directs prospective buyers to DarGlobal sales for current unit availability, pricing and payment-plan details. This project description does not establish current inventory.

title: Trump Tower Jeddah
text: DarGlobal's project page describes Trump Tower Jeddah as a 47-floor branded seafront residential tower on the Jeddah Corniche, with one- to four-bedroom apartments and three- and four-bedroom penthouses. The page lists areas from 70 to 365 square metres and expected completion in December 2029. It says prospective buyers can contact the sales team for current availability and payment-plan details. Project-page details are not a live inventory feed.

title: Tierra Viva — design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini
text: DarGlobal describes Tierra Viva as a gated villa community in Benahavís on the Costa del Sol, with design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini. Its page gives two different area statements: the introductory description says villas range from 700 to 1,450 square metres, while the property facts list 680 to 1,034 square metres. The page states expected completion in June 2028 and says buyers should contact sales for current pricing and unit availability. Preserve the conflicting area statements as shown on the source page; do not select or reconcile one without confirmation.

title: Marea, Interiors by Missoni
text: DarGlobal's Marea page describes a gated development within the Finca Cortesin estate. The page says residences have two, three or four bedrooms and areas from 223 to 553 square metres. It states Phase 1 completed in 2024 and the full development is scheduled for completion in December 2027. Current availability, pricing and payment-plan details are directed to the sales team.

title: DarGlobal Mansions, Interiors by Fendi Casa
location: Rayana, Wadi Safar, Diriyah, near Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
text: DarGlobal's project page describes a collection of seven Fendi Casa mansions in the gated Rayana community at Wadi Safar, near Riyadh. It lists plot areas from 2,035 to 4,623 square metres and total built-up areas from 2,192 to 4,406 square metres. Status: under development. The listed community amenities include dining and leisure experiences, walking/running/cycling tracks, parks and activity areas, children's play areas, Trump International Golf Club, community gardens, wellness-oriented retail, and gated entrances. These project details do not confirm current unit availability or price.

title: AIDA masterplan — announcement of partnership with OMRAN Group
text: DarGlobal's 24 March 2022 announcement says AIDA is a mixed-use development in the Yiti and Yankat areas of Muscat, developed in partnership with Oman Tourism Development Company (OMRAN Group). The announcement describes a 3.5 million square metre development planned in three stages, with villas, townhouses and low-rise apartments. It gives the announcement-date investment value as SAR 6 billion. These are announcement-era figures and descriptions, not a current completion or availability statement.

title: HY 2026 business update — figures for the six months ended 30 June 2026
text: DarGlobal's interim update reports revenue of US$258.0 million for the six months ended 30 June 2026, portfolio gross development value (GDV) of US$23.0 billion, and cumulative contracted sales of US$3.9 billion across 4,380 units as of that update. These are company-reported, date-specific figures; GDV is not unit price, realized revenue, or current inventory. The update also refers to projects including Rayana and Trump Plaza Jeddah.

title: DarGlobal announces new Jeddah mixed-use development
text: DarGlobal's 16 November 2026 announcement describes plans for a new mixed-use Jeddah development with an estimated GDV of approximately SAR 1 billion (US$267 million). It says land was acquired for approximately US$56 million and further details, including the architectural concept, residential offerings and official launch date, would be announced later. The announcement does not name the international brand or confirm individual units, pricing or availability.
